summary: Climber injured on the Hotlanta route of the Atlantis buttress, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP, after pulling a large boulder off the wall while leading a pitch; ankle, chest and facial injuries; combined park, Ouray Mountain Rescue, West Elk Mountain Rescue and Western State Mountain Rescue teams raised him 1,800 ft to the North Rim during a spring storm with whiteout, heavy wet snow and gusty winds; Durango man taken to a medical facility in stable condition
location: Atlantis buttress (Hotlanta route), Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP; Ouray Mountain Rescue; West Elk Mountain Rescue; Western State Mountain Rescue
notes: NPS morning report dated 2014-04-16; injured-climber rescue Sunday 2014-04-13; report received Saturday evening 2014-04-12; KVNF 2014-04-15 newscast "Man rescued from fall in the Black Canyon" corroborates the Hotlanta rescue (opened run 575)
